name: Sriram Kommana
title: Commit City: a playable comic by Sriram Kommana
description: The portfolio of Sriram Kommana, a student developer who builds multiplayer games, AI tools and developer tools. Read it, or ride through it as a 3-minute playable comic.
bubble: I build things, break them, and keep the receipts.

about.caption: Who's driving?
about.lead: I'm Sriram. I build things people can play with, and tools that are honest about how they work.
paragraphs: So far that has meant a live cricket auction game, a 3D multiplayer prop hunt, a tool that tracks how a codebase's architecture drifts over time, and a video clipper that runs entirely on my own laptop.
